name: Three Capes Track
description: A booked hut walk on the Tasman Peninsula, from Denmans Cove (reached by boat from Port Arthur) past Surveyors, Munro and Retakunna cabins to Fortescue Bay. The out-and-back walks to Cape Pillar and Cape Hauy are carried as side trips; Munro Cabin is 2 km along the Cape Pillar track, so it sits on that side trip rather than on the main line.
